investigation_notes.Description: PowerShell command recursively lists files under C:\\Users for sensitive extensions (.kdbx, .pst, .docx) and writes the results to a local CSV. The activity could be related to legitimate admin data discovery, as there is no observed external network connectivity or known malicious indicators in the evidence. Given the lack of network exfiltration and absence of hash reputation data, the alert is treated as Low Priority, with a watchful stance for any new indicators or changed context.
